metadata.title: NVIDIA Corp., Caterpillar share losses lead Dow's nearly 225-point fall - MarketWatch

content.text:
Dow Update
NVIDIA Corp., Caterpillar share losses lead Dow's nearly 225-point fall
The Dow Jones Industrial Average is trading down Tuesday morning with shares of NVIDIA Corp. and Caterpillar seeing the biggest losses for the blue-chip average.
The Dow Dow Jones Industrial Average was most recently trading 224 points, or 0.4%, lower, as shares of NVIDIA Corp. NVIDIA Corp. and Caterpillar Caterpillar Inc. have contributed to the blue-chip gauge's intraday decline.
